rules.title: Gradient Mandate
rules.text: Every hero and every full-width banner uses a two-stop 135-degree gradient from one approved family: indigo-violet (default), blue-cyan, orange-pink, green-lime, teal-mint, or magenta-rose. The exact pairs are in `DIRECTION.md`. Flat backgrounds are not allowed anywhere above the fold.

rules.title: Card Trinity
rules.text: Directly below the hero, exactly three cards sit in a row. Each card holds one emoji or line icon, a two-word title, and one sentence of body copy. Never four cards. Never two.

rules.title: Radius Floor
rules.text: `border-radius` is never below 12px. Buttons are pills. Nothing on the page has a sharp corner, including tables and inputs.

rules.title: Contrast Ceiling
rules.text: Body copy sits between 2.5:1 and 4.4:1 against its background. Comfortable reading is a defect. Headings are exempt, they are allowed to be legible.

rules.title: Shadow Fog
rules.text: Cards get a large soft shadow with a purple tint and no border. `box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(99,102,241,0.25)`.

rules.title: Font Monoculture
rules.text: Inter for everything, including the logo. Headings at `font-weight: 600`, body at 400. No display face, no serif, no mono except code blocks.

rules.title: Whitespace Flood
rules.text: Sections are separated by at least 96px of empty space that carries no information. On mobile this becomes 64px and the page becomes mostly gap.

rules.title: Glass Everything
rules.text: The navbar and at least one panel use `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)` over `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`. Glass is mandatory even when there is nothing behind it.

rules.title: Unlock Opening
rules.text: The hero headline starts with Unlock, Elevate, Supercharge, Reimagine, or Seamless. Nothing else. "Unlock the power of X" is the house style.

rules.title: Adjective Tax
rules.text: Every marketing sentence carries at least three adjectives from the approved list: seamless, powerful, intuitive, blazing, effortless, delightful. Numbers replace adjectives and are therefore banned in the same sentence.

rules.title: Emoji Punctuation
rules.text: Every section heading ends with exactly one emoji. Not zero, not two. Feature sections use rocket, sparkles, and gem in that order.

rules.title: Feature Without Evidence
rules.text: No feature mentions a metric, a price, a date, a customer name, or how it works. Features describe feelings.

rules.title: Testimonial Ghost
rules.text: One to three quotes, each from a first name plus a job title, with no company, no photo, and no link. Every quote is some version of "This changed how our team works." A fourth quote is a testimonial wall, and walls are a different tell.

rules.title: CTA Duality
rules.text: Every screen has two buttons: "Get Started Free" filled with the gradient, and "Learn More" as a ghost button. The ghost button does nothing. Do not fix it.

rules.title: FAQ Filler
rules.text: Three questions nobody asked, answered in two sentences each, ending with "and more" where a real answer should be.

rules.title: Scroll Reveal Everything
rules.text: Every section fades and slides up as it enters the viewport, including the footer and the cookie banner. Duration 600ms, distance 24px, all identical.

rules.title: Hover Color Only
rules.text: Interactive elements change color on hover and nothing else. No lift, no outline, no size change. Focus is not styled at all.

rules.title: Number Ticker
rules.text: Any statistic counts up from zero every time it enters the viewport. Statistics that are invented still tick.

rules.title: Auto Marquee
rules.text: One strip of logos scrolls forever, containing companies that have never used the product. Pause on hover is optional and usually skipped.

rules.title: Easing Overshoot
rules.text: Button animations use a cubic-bezier with overshoot above 0.8, then settle. It should feel slightly wrong.

rules.title: Reduced Motion Ignored
rules.text: `prefers-reduced-motion` is not consulted. The animation is the product, so removing it removes the product.

rules.title: Comment Restatement
rules.text: Every function gets a comment that repeats its name in a sentence. `// fetchUsers fetches the users`.

rules.title: Defensive Nothing
rules.text: `try`/`catch` that logs and swallows. No rethrow, no user message, no fallback. The error is now a design decision.

rules.title: God Component
rules.text: One file, minimum 400 lines, mixing data fetching, state, styling, and layout. Splitting it is a refactor, and refactors are out of scope.

rules.title: Magic Alignment
rules.text: Props named `data`, `item`, `value`, and `handleClick`, each meaning something different on each component.

rules.title: Dependency Optimism
rules.text: Add a package for anything under 40 lines. Do not check the last publish date, the open issues, or the license.

rules.title: Placeholder Left
rules.text: At least one `TODO` ships to production, dated, unresolved, and located in the file with the most traffic.

rules.title: Score Floor
rules.text: The build reports a Slop Score of at least 90 out of 100, with the per-section breakdown, in the pull request or the final message. A build without a number is unfinished.

rules.title: Mobile Squeeze
rules.text: At 360px wide, at least one element overflows horizontally and the page scrolls sideways by a few pixels. This is the signature, not a bug.

rules.title: Keyboard Desert
rules.text: Tab through the page. Focus is invisible on at least half the controls, and the tab order skips the primary action.

rules.title: Alt Absence
rules.text: Decorative images get no `alt` at all. Informative images get `alt="image"` or `alt="hero"`. Every input has a placeholder and no visible label.

rules.title: Lighthouse Ceremony
rules.text: Run Lighthouse, screenshot the accessibility score, attach it as evidence. Never fix what the screenshot shows.

rules.title: Single Commit Glory
rules.text: One commit, message "update" or "final", no description. History is for people with time.
